purpose: This silver table holds cleaned retail order line items sourced from the bronze online_retail_ii table, intended to feed sales, returns, and customer analytics downstream.
usage: Consumers should treat invoice plus stockcode as the row grain, filter or segment on is_return for return/cancellation lines, and explicitly handle null customer_id as unidentified or guest transactions rather than assuming every order is attributable to a customer.
limitations: Roughly 1.12% of bronze rows (duplicate_row_rate 0.011188) were exact duplicates and are excluded by the dedupe strategy; description is null for about 0.5% of rows and customer_id is null for about 29.8% of rows, both retained as nullable rather than imputed, so downstream aggregations by customer will undercount unlinked transactions.
